faq.q: Can family members follow different programmes?
faq.a: Discuss each person’s health history and goals separately with the doctor. Travelling together does not mean everyone needs the same therapies or length of stay. Ask our team how the recommended programmes, dates and accommodation can be arranged together before you confirm a booking.

faq.q: Can I plan a stay with my parents?
faq.a: Yes, you can discuss a shared stay with our team. Tell us about your parents’ health, current treatment, mobility and assistance needs. Each person’s suitability and programme should be assessed individually. Confirm room access, travel arrangements and any support you need before making your booking.

faq.q: How are children’s care and participation decided?
faq.a: Tell the team each child’s age and the reason for your enquiry. Ask the doctor what care or participation may be appropriate after assessment. Do not assume an adult programme, therapy schedule or yoga session is suitable for a child simply because the family is travelling together.

faq.q: Can someone accompany us without having treatment?
faq.a: Ask patient care about companion arrangements for your dates. Explain who will receive treatment and who plans to accompany them, then confirm villa occupancy, meals and applicable charges. Availability and the final quotation need to be agreed before booking; a shared stay does not automatically mean a shared treatment package.

faq.q: Is the initial doctor consultation free?
faq.a: Yes. The initial doctor consultation is free. Share your health history, current treatment and questions so you can discuss whether a stay may suit you. Before booking, ask for a quotation covering your programme, accommodation and any later services. The free consultation does not mean that treatment is free.

faq.q: What should I check in my quotation?
faq.a: Ask for the recommended programme, number of nights, villa occupancy and the care included for your dates. Confirm which medicines, tests, specialist services or travel arrangements cost extra. Review the full quotation with our team before booking, so you understand both the stay and any additional charges.

blocks.text: Is this food suitable for elderly people?

What ages are included / what about teenagers / seniors?

Do families stay together or separately?
